flags.observation: "Kayfabe Nights is still holding the city's debt." Debt has no anchor in cards or concept; storytelling-for-survival and wrestling territory absent; no satirical bite.
"The seal stays rusted; nobody gets that last word." mirrors the intro wording; the closing turn is thin, not thought-provoking.
"But the ebony horse:" repeats the But family eight lines after beat 3; So (beats 7, 15) and Until (19, 27) also under ten apart.
"Yet the Petrified Market's crowd:" contrast word with no contrast, right after a But opener; the fragment does not bridge into Solomon's Vessel.
"Until the steward's mistake:" calls back into Harun al-Rashid, a different story; the callback is formal, with no therefore or but logic.
"But the market's bargain:" gives the Petrified Market a bargain it never had; hollow callback, props not people (Tip 3).
Power names tacked on as trailing labels: "sonic attack"; likewise "suicide dive", "aerial assault", "sabotage", "insanity", "audit", "rage", "clue" elsewhere.
"witty verse boosts faces" recites the power as a rule; same pattern in "enforcer destroys corruption" (beat 20) and "prevent identity reveals" (beat 30).
"the bell, match ends by the King" is garbled syntax; also "keep marks believing, Bizarro sell" (beat 27). Meaning gets lost when spoken.
"to be continued next night, match." ends on a dangling word that breaks the cadence of the line.
118 characters including opener; beats 3, 7, 15, 19, 23, 25, 27 also exceed 105, beyond one breath.
"it's a crime" cuts the card's crime scene, shifting the lore from a place to an accusation.
